abstract: We present a case of a 22 year pregnant lady with a fetus having sacrococcygeal teratoma. The patient presented at 35 weeks of gestation with an ultrasound report showing growth at the sacral region. Emergency caesarean section was performed at 36 week and a baby girl with a huge mass on her sacral region was delivered. She was operated upon by the pediatric surgeons on the same day and the mass was excised. Histopathology of the mass confirmed the diagnosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma with an immature component. The infant is now 6 months old and there is no sign of recurrence.
abstract_ja: 我々は、22歳の妊婦で胎児に仙尾部奇形腫がみられた症例を報告する。患者は妊娠35週で、仙骨部の増大を示す超音波検査報告により受診した。妊娠36週で緊急帝王切開が行われ、仙骨部に巨大な腫瘤を持つ女児が出生した。同日、小児外科医が手術を行い、腫瘤を切除した。腫瘤の病理組織学的検査により、未熟成分を伴う仙尾部奇形腫と確定した。児は現在生後6か月で、再発の兆候はない。
